title: sukha sutta
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.
groupSub: The Nearest Cause for the Origination of dukkha

paras.en: “Bhikkhus, there are these three vedanā. What three? Pleasant vedanā, painful vedanā, neither-painful-nor-pleasant vedanā. These are the three vedanā.

Whether it be pleasant or painful
along with the neither-painful-nor-pleasant,
both the internal and the external,
whatever there is that is felt:
having known, “This is dukkha,
deceptive, disintegrating,”
having touched and touched them, seeing their fall,
thus one loses one’s attachment for them.”
